title: 2018 Prediction v3
source: MoEE Feb 2024 blueprint — credit-hour topic weights + cognitive domain mix (Apply/Analyze/Create-heavy)

focusGuide.Fundamentals of Programming: Blueprint 11% programming theme — algorithms, modular design, debugging traces.
focusGuide.C++: Syntax traces, memory, references, and OOP-based design choices.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Structure selection, complexity analysis, BFS/DFS, sorting/search reasoning.
focusGuide.Web Development: Blueprint 9 items — HTTP/API design, AJAX, sessions, responsive integration.
focusGuide.Android: Components, lifecycle, permissions, ethical mobile design.
focusGuide.Software Engineering: Requirements, change control, maintenance, release planning.
focusGuide.Software Architecture: Quality attributes, patterns, service boundaries, scalability.
focusGuide.Project Management: WBS, EVM, risk register, agile/waterfall trade-offs.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Test plans, coverage, regression, incident reporting.
focusGuide.Networking: Subnetting, routing, OSI/TCP behavior, campus network design.
focusGuide.Security: Threat modeling, crypto, access control, incident response.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Search, logic, supervised/unsupervised ML, model evaluation pipelines.
focusGuide._blueprint: Feb 2024 MoEE blueprint mix: Remember 3 · Understand 21 · Apply 22 · Analyze 10 · Evaluate 6 · Create 33 · Affective 5. Questions use scenarios, traces, design choices, and professional-judgment stems—not simple definition recall.
